sections.title: Morning Shift (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Both chargers for bodycam gone missing.
Charlie Route commenced. Welfare check inside Starbucks — all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Welfare check inside McDonald's, Mid City and 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check on Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full walkthrough completed, no issues found. Standby.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive check-in. Location thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check along Wakefield Street, no issues found.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, no issues found.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare checks inside Atrium on Elliott up towards Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Welfare check on City Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks commenced along all stores, all clear. Standby.
Welfare check along Sky Mart Convenience Store and Formery, all clear. Patrolling down Albert Street.
Arrived at corner of Albert and Wyndham Street. Checked into Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe, all clear.
Welfare check around the Cathedral Church and Federal Square commenced.
Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Customs and Albert Street. Area thoroughly checked, no issues found.
Welfare check inside Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check inside OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Arrived at Queens Wharf. Scoped the area for possible vagrants, all clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed and welfare checks inside all stores, all clear. Standby.
Due to no activity requiring assistance, continuing patrols. Ending Charlie Route.
Bravo Route commenced. Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Welfare check inside Adidas, Movenpick and Four Square, all clear.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Welfare checks on all stores, all clear.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street. Welfare check inside Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe and other stores, no issues found. Standby.
Proceeding towards next checkpoint due to no activity.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Welfare check on all stores and businesses, no issues found. Checked in with static guards present, all clear.
Welfare check commenced along lower High Street and O'Connell Lane, all clear.
Welfare check along Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. Location thoroughly checked, no issues found.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep around the area. Standby.
Continuing patrols. Welfare checks commenced on all stores within upper High Street.
Arrived at corner intersection of Lorne and High Street, all clear. Welfare checks along the lane.
Arrived at corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street. Area thoroughly checked, no issues to report.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check on Nando's, Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Response call from Vans regarding a male inside the store who does not seem mentally stable. Assistance requested to check up on him. POI has some of their clothing items on him.

Arrived at response location. Spoke with the POI; the store manager confirmed his card was declined and the POI was sitting down talking to himself. Guards kindly asked him to take off all the items belonging to Vans; he complied inside the changing room. Vans did not wish to trespass him. Guards advised him not to cause trouble for other stores. Last seen walking down Queen Street. Standby.
Leaving standby and continuing patrols. Ending Bravo Route.
Arrived at HQ. Quick break before continuing patrols.
Break concluded. Heading back onto routes.
Welfare check inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks commenced along all stores, all clear. Standby.
Welfare check around AA Insurance, Mr Barber and City Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Albert and Wellesley Street intersection, all clear.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Made way through Bledisloe Alley, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep commenced, all clear.

Response call from Cotton On regarding smoke coming out of the rubbish bin in front of Daily Drip. Guards advised them to call the fire department in case of escalation; seconds later someone tipped a bucket of water over the bin. Assistance no longer needed. Standby at Aotea Square.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive check-in. Location thoroughly checked, no issues found. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check inside Metro Entertainment City. Walkthrough completed, no issues found.
Welfare check on Daiso Japan, following up with yesterday's issue, all clear.
Arrived at Mid City. Chat with the static guard present, all clear.
Welfare check along Strand Arcade and Darby Street businesses, all clear.
Welfare check on Cosmetic Clinic and Footlocker. Chat with staff, no issues occurring.
Welfare check on Cotton On, Nike, Lotus and Starbucks, no issues.
Taking lunch break while preparing for changeover to afternoon shift.
Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Noted: 1 charger for bodycam display found; one more still missing.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:50 – 21:22)
items: Equipment handover: 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras plus 1 charger.
Debrief with morning shift complete. Commencing welfare patrol sweeps up Queen Street.
Nike welfare check complete, no issues to report from store.

Confronted by a suspicious individual while doing a welfare check. Vagrant was being aggressive towards the HOTC guards and staff and was asked to vacate the premises. Vagrant also proceeded to record the guards. No further issues. Resuming patrol towards Victoria Street.
Victoria Street welfare check complete, no issues to report. Heading towards the Cathedral.
Quick walkthrough Federal Street, clear, no issues.
Welfare check on the Cathedral, clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrol to Commercial Bay.
Full welfare sweep around Commercial Bay complete, no issues to report. Making way up High via Gore and Fort.
Quick walkthrough Tyler Street, clear, no issues.
Welfare sweep on Gore / Fort Street, clear, no issues to report. Continuing to Chancery via High Street.
High Street and Freyberg Square welfare sweep complete, no issues to report.
Chancery Square welfare checks clear, no issues to report. Making way towards Aotea via Lorne Street.
Lorne Street welfare checks complete, no issues to report.
Auckland Library welfare check complete, no issues to report.
Arriving at Aotea Square. Commencing welfare sweeps.
Aotea Square sweep complete, no issues to report. Making way to Elliott Street then Queen Street to maintain presence towards lower Queen Street.
Elliott Stables and Elliott / Darby Street welfare check complete, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for building sweeps.
Building sweep complete, no issues to report. Standing by at HQ to charge ops phone while waiting for response calls.
Welfare check Victoria Street 77 Convenience, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Cathedral, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Ace, all clear, no issues.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:25 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Standing by in office to charge ops phone due to low percentage.
Received a message from a fellow guard regarding an unknown male stealing staff belongings at the Viaduct waterfront. Report has already been made.
Taking the Take 10 guard down to Quay Street site.
Welfare check on Bar101, checking for any intoxicated people in line, all clear, no issues.
Standing by outside McDonald's Queen Street waiting for additional guard to arrive at 00:58.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, no further issues.
Welfare check Potato, all clear, no further issues.

While on patrol, heard a commotion at Bar101. Guards intervened and de-escalated the situation without any physical restraint and told both parties to leave, which they complied with. Standby for any further issues.
Bar101 and Elliott Stables all clear, no further issues. Continuing patrols.
Checked Darby Street and Elliott Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal Street towards Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store and Custom Mart, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort Street, and the bottom of High Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High Street Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear, no issues. Echo Route complete.
Heading back to HQ for floor checks and 30-minute break.
Handover to morning shift. Night shift complete.
